notToBeConfusedWith.name: Mango juice
notToBeConfusedWith.note: The pressed and often diluted drink sold in cartons; a recipe naming the fruit means the flesh, blended in, not the juice poured from a bottle.

forms.label: Raw
forms.sourceNote: Mangos, raw. Public domain. Weighed as peeled flesh, in grams. No liquid-measure density exists for this record, so the density-classes.json 'juice-sweet' class stands in as the nearest match for blended fruit flesh and the figure is marked estimated.
